title: AsyncAPI v2 - SASL SCRAM Authentication
description: Contains information about SASL SCRAM Authentication. SASL SCRAM is secure password-based challenge-response authentication mechanism that uses Apache Kafka Documentation or similar platforms, utilizing salts and cryptographic hashes like Confluent Platform SCRAM Overview (SCRAM-SHA-256 and SCRAM-SHA-512) to protect credentials from network sniffing and replay attacks
